source_name: Стопанска банка АД Скопје — годишен извештај за работењето
why_relevant: Worked example of a bank's own annual operating report carrying employee counts, organisational structure and branch network — the per-bank primary layer to pair with NBRSM aggregates. Same pattern applies to kb.mk, nlb.mk, halkbank.mk, sparkasse.mk.

source_name: Кодекси за корпоративно управување на котираните банки (пример: ТТК Банка, УНИ Банка)
why_relevant: Bank-published governance codes are versioned and dated (TTK v. 30.06.2025; UNI Banka v.19, 31.01.2025). Version bumps are a low-noise proxy for statute/organisation changes, and the codes name the bodies and committees whose membership must be disclosed.

source_name: Портал за социјално партнерство / ЕСС документи (МДТ портал)
why_relevant: Government portal hosting social-partnership and collective-agreement documents signed between government, employers and the union confederations — the tripartite layer above bank-level bargaining.

source_name: КХВ — Годишни извештаи (список на издадени согласности и решенија)
why_relevant: Because KHV does not publish a chronological decisions register on the web, the annual report is the practical archive: it enumerates consents/решенија granted during the year, including approvals of directors of brokerage houses and depository/market participants.

source_name: МТСП — Закон за инспекцијата на труд и подзаконски акти
why_relevant: Legal baseline for what inspectorate outputs exist and are publishable, and what an employer must do on collective redundancy — needed to interpret disclosure gaps and to frame FOI requests.

source_name: НБРСМ — Одлука за издавање дозволи и согласности на платежна институција и институција за електронски пари и за содржината и начинот на водење на регистрите
why_relevant: The by-law that defines what the payment-institution/EMI registers must contain and how they are kept — tells the collector precisely which fields (including authorised persons and management) are legally required to appear, and hence what can be monitored.

source_name: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) — Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems, consolidated text
why_relevant: Defines the licensed-entity categories, the fit-and-proper/management-approval requirements and the registers the National Bank must keep — the legal scaffolding that makes leadership changes at PSPs publicly observable.

source_name: Закон за банките (consolidated text on NBRSM site)
why_relevant: Primary statute defining bank governance bodies, appointment/consent duties and registration obligations. It is the legal basis that makes the registry/gazette layer exhaustive, and it fixes the correct Macedonian terminology for board roles used in filings.

source_name: НБРСМ — Одлука за издавање согласности (пречистен текст)
why_relevant: Sets out the Governor's prior-consent procedure for appointing bank management-board and supervisory-board members. Establishes that every bank board appointment passes through NBRSM before it can be registered at CRM — i.e. a second, earlier signal point in the legally compelled chain.

source_name: МБ — Правила за котација (обврски за објавување)
why_relevant: Defines the taxonomy of mandatory disclosure categories and the deadlines — needed to know which governance events must be filed, how fast, and what the exact category labels are that the RSS titles use.

source_name: МБ — Извештај за следење на усогласеноста на котираните друштва со Кодексот за корпоративно управување
why_relevant: Annual MSE compliance report on corporate-governance practice of listed companies — gives structural context (board composition norms, independence, committee structures) against which individual bank leadership moves can be read.

source_name: МБ — архивски пример: Развојна Банка на Северна Македонија, 'Промени во органите на управување и раководење'
why_relevant: Confirms the exact announcement URL grammar (/mk/announcement/{d}/{m}/{yyyy}/{issuer}/{category-slug}) and the disclosure category slug 'Changes-in-management-bodies' — the highest-precision crawl key for this cell. Also shows that non-listed banks (Development Bank) disclose through the Free Market segment.

source_name: ССМ document archive (collective agreements, statutes)
why_relevant: Raw collective-agreement texts and union statutes hosted as DOC/PDF under a predictable path; useful for tracking the general economy-wide collective agreement text that frames bank-level agreements and redundancy procedures.

source_name: EBRD — Nominee Directors / Board Practice guidance
why_relevant: Explains how EBRD appoints nominee directors to investee banks — the mechanism by which an IFI shareholding converts into a board seat at an MK bank; needed to interpret board-composition changes correctly.

source_name: nezavisen.mk — MK general news, banking appointment coverage
why_relevant: Mainstream MK outlet that carries CEO-level appointment stories with career-history detail (e.g. the Halkbank AD Skopje CEO change, including prior deputy-CEO roles and dates) — corroborates and dates what LinkedIn shows self-reported.

source_name: AI Tech Summit 'Filip Avramchev' (Skopje) — speaker roster
why_relevant: Recurring Skopje tech summit bringing global AI leaders; its programme/speaker page is where MK bank CTO/CDO-level and vendor-side people appear with current titles. Relevant to the payments-technology hiring signal; the konekt.mk piece is the pointer to the official summit site and its speakers section.

source_name: Bertelsmann Transformation Index (BTI) — North Macedonia country report
why_relevant: Biennial governance monitor with narrative on state capacity, politicisation of appointments and regulatory independence — the analytical frame for judging whether an MK bank/regulator leadership change is technocratic or political.

source_name: EBA — third-country equivalence annex on North Macedonia
why_relevant: EBA equivalence annexes assess the MK supervisory regime including governance and fit-and-proper requirements for bank management bodies — a rare EU-level, English description of how MK regulates who may sit on a bank board, useful as a rulebook reference for interpreting A5 events.

source_name: Login Systems — banking-integration reference posts (Business Central + MK banks)
why_relevant: A partner-published MK-language reference post describing bank-integration functionality delivered for MK customers. Small ERP/integration partners publish this kind of named-bank detail far more freely than tier-1 vendors, making them a high-yield, low-competition source for who connects to which MK bank's rails.

source_name: Open Government Partnership — commitment MK0122 'Public access to the Central Register'
why_relevant: Documents the government commitment to make basic CRM data publicly and freely available, with implementation status. Tells the collector how far free access extends now and what is due to open next — i.e. how the access constraints on this cell will change.

source_name: US Department of State — Investment Climate Statement, North Macedonia
why_relevant: Annual English monitor with a dedicated financial-sector section describing bank ownership, sector structure and SOE/state-appointment practice; a stable, free, machine-readable alternative to paywalled analyst reports for baseline organisational context.
